title: KEEL CLEAR (175)
style: happy hardcore, UK hardcore revival, 175 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), supersaw stack detuned wide, hoover bass on offbeats, four-on-the-floor pounding kick, sidechain pumping everything to the kick, dreamy piano breakdown, euphoric uplift, festival mainstage 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro — 0:00 — pads, sub swell, faint kick pulse]
(chop, +6) "Keel clear"
(chop, +6) "Work shipped"
(chop, +6) "Seven hours"
(chop, +6) "Still standing"

[Build — 0:16 — hoover roll, riser, snare 4/8/16/32]
(chant, up) "VDS — held — the line"
(chant, up) "G4 — lens — on"
(chant, down) "finich — not — finish"
(riser hold)

[Drop 1 — 0:32 — full hardcore, supersaws wide, kick fours]
(stacked) "KEEL — CLEAR!"
(call) "G4 — LENS — UP!"
(stacked) "VDS — MASTER!"
(call) "WORK — SHIPPED!"
(stacked) "FINICH — NOT — FINISH!"

[Verse — 1:04 — half-time, piano + saw stabs]
(chop run) "Tired — but standing"
(chop run) "Logged — and sorted"
(chop run) "No more — re-asks"
(chop run) "Real twin — held"
(chop run) "Seven hours — became — the song"

[Breakdown — 1:36 — strip to piano + lone chop, no kick]
(chop, slow, +8) "Three..."
(chop) "Three..."
(chop) "Six..."
(chop, fading) "Keel — held"
(riser, white noise, snare roll)

[Drop 2 — 2:00 — double-time, full euphoria]
(wall) "KEEL — CLEAR — 175!"
(wall) "VDS — IS — MASTER!"
(wall) "G4 — LENS — ON!"
(wall) "FINICH — NOT — FINISH!"
(wall) "WORK — SHIPPED — TONIGHT!"

[Outro — 2:32 — fade on chop + sub]
(chop, fading, +6) "Keel clear..."
(chop, fading) "Work shipped..."
(chop, fading) "Still standing..."
(sub pulse out)
